subject: The colony council hall at dusk, a long table with three groups facing each other: weathered born-here colonists, newcomers in clean grey, and a few old officers in faded ship jumpsuits. An empty chair at the head.
notes: Barrens Part 3. Screenprint light. Barrens' own dun and red ground. Never show the Mocker itself: only what it leaves and who sees it.
